name: The residual's bottom 10% laid at the Betfair SP, to win and to be placed
hypothesis: Runners whose card-only residual on the BSP is in the bottom 10% of their race (the frozen lay_bottom10 cut) are overbet at the SP, to win and to be placed: a lay at the win SP and at the place SP earns after commission.

evidence.claim: development only: +1.233% and +1.420% of liability on two seed halves, 2024 to May 2026, deflated Sharpe 0.990 and 0.9995 at 37,996 greyhound trials
the place route: +2.662% of liability (2.137 to 3.187), t 8.34, deflated Sharpe 0.999986 at 38,018 greyhound trials, development only
no forward day yet: its paper forward test's gate is read once at 120 settled days
real orders only with GREYHOUND_SP_LAY=live; GBP50 a lay to win and GBP50 to be placed, one GBP1,000 daily loss limit at the worst case, fixed in code

approved.source: the owner, 21 Nov 2026: "Put any possible profitable strategies live"; asked, chose the bottom-10% SP lay only, GBP50 a lay, GBP300 daily loss limit, live today, restarting today's paper-models run; later that day: "yes add the place lay live, same limit", "GBP500 daily loss limit", then "daily loss limit GBP1000"
